title: Reborn After Betrayal: The Dragon King's True Bride
description: After being murdered alongside her kids, Lyra gets a second chance at life and lets her greedy sister steal the golden prince. Exiled and mocked by her clan, she gets claimed by a dangerous ancient dragon king everyone fears. But her enemies have no idea about the lethal secret power she carries—or how far her new king will go to protect her.
